cohort: Two male neonates with cyanotic-type congenital heart disease who were subsequently diagnosed with COVID-19.
finding: One neonate with cyanotic heart disease and COVID-19 experienced cardiopulmonary arrest and died, while another neonate with similar conditions but a hypoplastic right ventricle showed improvement and was discharged.
followup_time: 1 week (for the second case, the first case died sooner)
gest_age: 37 weeks GA (first case), 38 weeks GA (second case)
